snippet.title: What If You Jumped Into a Hole Through the Earth? 🌍
snippet.description:
You jump into a tunnel that goes straight through the planet. You fall faster and faster, hit 28,000 km/h at the center, feel totally weightless… and then gravity flips. 🌍 Wait until you see where you end up.

Imagined scenario, real physics.

FACT CHECK
• Classic gravity-tunnel physics (uniform Earth, no air): the fall through the planet takes about 42 minutes and you pass the center at about 7.9 km/s (~28,000 km/h). Then you slow down, pop out on the other side and fall back again, forever.
• Earth's inner core is hotter than 5,000°C (USGS / NASA).
• The point on the exact opposite side of the United States is in the Indian Ocean, southwest of Australia.
